SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY AI.ASNDIT) AS RNUM , AI.ASNDKY AS ASNDKY , AI.ASNDIT AS ASNDIT , AI.SKUKEY AS SKUKEY , NVL(TRIM(AI.LOCARV),SW.LOCARV) AS LOCAKY , SUM(AI.QTYASN) AS QTYASN , (AI.QTYASN-AI.QTYRCV) AS QTYRCV , AI.UOMKEY AS UOMKEY , AI.DESC01 AS DESC01 , AI.EANCOD AS EANCOD , '99991231' AS RCVLMT , AI.LOTA11 AS LOTA11 , AI.LOTA13 AS LOTA13 , (AI.QTYASN-AI.QTYRCV) AS ASNQTY , 0 AS QTYBOX , 0 AS QTYRMN , NVL(MI.QTPUOM,0) AS QTIPSU , AI.QTYRCV AS QTYRCV1 , SUM(AI.QTYASN - AI.QTYRCV) AS QTABLE
FROM ASNDI AI INNER JOIN ASNDH AH ON AH.ASNDKY = AI.ASNDKY LEFT OUTER JOIN SKUMA SM ON SM.OWNRKY = AH.OWNRKY AND SM.SKUKEY = AI.SKUKEY LEFT OUTER JOIN SKUWC SW ON SW.WAREKY = AH.WAREKY AND SW.OWNRKY = AH.OWNRKY AND SW.SKUKEY = AI.SKUKEY LEFT OUTER JOIN MEASI MI ON MI.WAREKY = AH.WAREKY AND MI.MEASKY = SW.MEASKY AND MI.UOMKEY = 'BOX' WHERE AI.ASNDKY = #ASNDKY#
GROUP BY AI.QTYASN , AI.QTYRCV , MI.QTPUOM , AI.LOTA13 , AI.LOTA11 , AI.EANCOD , AI.UOMKEY , AI.LOCARV , SW.LOCARV , AI.SKUKEY , AI.ASNDIT , AI.ASNDKY , AI.DESC01
SELECT COUNT(1) AS CNT FROM ASNDI AI INNER JOIN ASNDH AH ON AH.ASNDKY = AI.ASNDKY WHERE 1= 1 AND (AH.ASNDKY = #ASNDKY# OR AI.ASNDKY||AI.ASNDIT = #ASNDKY#) AND SKUKEY = #SKUKEY#
SELECT DOCUTY AS VALUE_COL , SHORTX AS TEXT_COL FROM DOCTM WHERE 1 = 1 AND DOCCAT = '100' AND DOCUTY = '112'

SELECT COUNT(1) AS CNT FROM ASNDH AH INNER JOIN ASNDI AI ON AI.ASNDKY = AH.ASNDKY WHERE AH.WAREKY = #SES_WAREKY# AND AH.OWNRKY = #SES_OWNER#
AND (AH.ASNDKY = #ASNINV# OR AI.ASNDKY||AI.ASNDIT = #ASNINV#)
AND AI.QTYASN - AI.QTYRCV > 0 AND AH.ASNTTY = '051'
AND AH.ASNDAT = #ASNDAT#

SELECT * FROM ASNDH AH INNER JOIN ASNDI AI ON AI.ASNDKY = AH.ASNDKY WHERE AH.WAREKY = #SES_WAREKY# AND AH.OWNRKY = #SES_OWNER# AND AH.ASNDKY = #ASNINV# AND AI.QTYASN - AI.QTYRCV > 0 AND AH.ASNTTY = '051'
AND AH.ASNDAT = #ASNDAT#

SELECT * FROM (SELECT AH.ASNDKY, AI.ASNDIT , #BARCOD# AS BARCOD , NVL(TRIM(AI.LOCARV),SW.LOCARV) AS LOCAKY , '112' AS ASNTTY , AH.ASNDKY AS REFDKY , AI.ASNDIT AS REFDIT , '100' AS REFCAT , TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD') AS REFDAT , AI.SEBELN AS SEBELN , AI.SEBELP AS SEBELP , DT.SHORTX AS ASNTTYNM , AH.DPTNKY AS PTNRKY , AI.SKUKEY , SM.EANCOD , SM.DESC01 , SM.ASKU01 , ' ' AS LOTA10 , AI.LOTA11 AS LOTA11 , TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') AS LOTA12 , AI.LOTA13 AS LOTA13 , ' ' AS TRNUID , SM.DUOMKY AS UOMKEY , SW.MEASKY , SUM(AI.QTYASN) AS QTYASN , SUM(AI.QTYASN - AI.QTYRCV) AS QTABLE , NVL(MI.QTPUOM,0) AS QTIPSU , (AI.QTYASN-AI.QTYRCV) AS QTYRCV , AI.QTYRCV AS QTYRCV1 , 0 AS QTYBOX , 0 AS QTYRMN , SM.INDBZL , NVL(SM.QTYMON,1) AS EXPIRED_LIMIT , NVL(SM.QTYSTD,1) AS WARNING_LIMIT , '99991231' AS RCVLMT , AH.DOCTXT AS DOCKNO , AH.DRELIN FROM ASNDH AH INNER JOIN ASNDI AI ON AI.ASNDKY = AH.ASNDKY INNER JOIN SKUMA SM ON SM.OWNRKY = AH.OWNRKY AND SM.SKUKEY = AI.SKUKEY INNER JOIN SKUWC SW ON SW.WAREKY = AH.WAREKY AND SW.OWNRKY = AH.OWNRKY AND SW.SKUKEY = AI.SKUKEY LEFT OUTER JOIN MEASI MI ON MI.WAREKY = AH.WAREKY AND MI.MEASKY = SW.MEASKY AND MI.UOMKEY = 'BOX' INNER JOIN DOCTM DT ON DT.DOCUTY = AH.ASNTTY LEFT OUTER JOIN WAHMA WF ON WF.WAREKY = AH.DPTNKY
WHERE AH.WAREKY = #SES_WAREKY# AND AH.OWNRKY = #SES_OWNER#
AND (AH.ASNDKY = #ASNINV# OR AI.ASNDKY || AI.ASNDIT = #ASNINV#)
AND AI.SKUKEY = #SKUKEY#
AND (AI.SKUKEY = #BARCOD# OR (AI.ASNDKY = SUBSTR(#BARCOD#,1,10) AND AI.ASNDIT = SUBSTR(#BARCOD#,11,6)) )
GROUP BY AH.ASNDKY , AI.ASNDIT , AH.ASNTTY , AH.DOCCAT , AI.SEBELN , AI.SEBELP , AH.DPTNKY , DT.SHORTX , AI.SKUKEY , SM.DESC01 , SM.ASKU01 , SM.DUOMKY , SW.MEASKY , MI.QTPUOM , SM.INDBZL , SM.EANCOD , SM.GTINCD , SM.ASKU05 , SM.QTYMON , SM.QTYSTD , AI.QTYRCV , AI.LOTA11 , AI.LOTA13 , AH.DOCTXT , AH.WAREKY , AI.LOTA10 , AH.DRELIN , AI.LOCARV , SW.LOCARV , AI.QTYASN ) WHERE ROWNUM = 1

SELECT '' AS ASNINV , '' AS BARCOD , '' AS ASNTTY , '' AS ASNTTYNM , '' AS WAREFR , '' AS SELLER , '' AS SELLERNM , '' AS SKUKEY , '' AS DESC01 , '' AS ASKU01 , '' AS LOTA11 /* 제조일자*/ , '' AS LOTA13 /* 유통기한*/ , '' AS RCVLMT , '' AS LOT1113 , '' AS TRNUID , '' AS UOMKEY , '' AS MEASKY , '' AS QTYASN , '' AS QTABLE , '' AS QTYRCV , '' AS QTIPSU , '' AS QTYBOX , '' AS QTYRMN , '' AS INDBZL FROM DUAL

SELECT COUNT(1) AS CNT FROM ASNDH AH INNER JOIN ASNDI AI ON AI.ASNDKY = AH.ASNDKY INNER JOIN SKUMA SM ON SM.OWNRKY = AH.OWNRKY AND SM.SKUKEY = AI.SKUKEY WHERE AH.WAREKY = #SES_WAREKY# AND AH.OWNRKY = #SES_OWNER#
AND (AH.ASNDKY = #ASNINV# OR AI.ASNDKY || AI.ASNDIT = #ASNINV#)
AND (AI.SKUKEY = #BARCOD# OR SM.EANCOD = #BARCOD# OR SM.GTINCD = #BARCOD# OR (AI.ASNDKY = SUBSTR(#BARCOD#,1,10) AND AI.ASNDIT = SUBSTR(#BARCOD#,11,6)))

SELECT CASE WHEN (SUM(STD.QTYRCV) + SUM(AI.QTYRCV)) > SUM(AI.QTYASN) THEN 'VALID_M1722' WHEN SM.SKUKEY IS NULL THEN 'MASTER_M0669' || '†' || STD.SKUKEY WHEN SW.IBPROT = 'V' THEN 'VALID_M1559' || '†' || SW.IBPROT WHEN BZ.PROCHA = 'V' THEN 'VALID_M1559' || '†' || BZ.PROCHA WHEN BZ.PTNRKY IS NULL THEN 'VALID_M1558' || '†' || STD.PTNRKY WHEN LM.LOCAKY IS NULL THEN 'OUT_M0070' || '†' || STD.LOCAKY WHEN TRIM(STD.LOTA13) IS NULL THEN 'VALID_M1604' || '†' || STD.SKUKEY WHEN TO_DATE(REPLACE(STD.LOTA12,'-',''), 'YYYYMMDD') > TO_DATE(REPLACE(STD.RCVLMT,'-',''), 'YYYYMMDD') THEN 'VALID_M1582' WHEN TRIM(BZ.PROCHA) IS NOT NULL THEN 'IN_M0143' WHEN AI.QTYASN = 0 THEN 'VALID_M1589' WHEN AI.QTYASN <= AI.QTYRCV THEN 'VALID_M1589' ELSE 'OK' END AS MSG FROM ( $VALIDATION_SQL$ ) STD LEFT OUTER JOIN ASNDI AI ON AI.ASNDKY = STD.ASNDKY AND AI.SKUKEY = STD.SKUKEY LEFT OUTER JOIN SKUMA SM ON SM.OWNRKY = #SES_OWNER# AND SM.SKUKEY = STD.SKUKEY LEFT OUTER JOIN SKUWC SW ON SW.WAREKY = STD.WAREKY AND SW.OWNRKY = STD.OWNRKY AND SW.SKUKEY = STD.SKUKEY LEFT OUTER JOIN BZPTN BZ ON BZ.OWNRKY = STD.OWNRKY AND BZ.PTNRKY = STD.PTNRKY AND BZ.PTNRTY = 'VD' LEFT OUTER JOIN LOCMA LM ON LM.WAREKY = STD.WAREKY AND LM.LOCAKY = STD.LOCAKY GROUP BY AI.QTYRCV , SM.SKUKEY , STD.SKUKEY , SW.IBPROT , SW.IBPROT , BZ.PROCHA , BZ.PROCHA , BZ.PTNRKY , STD.PTNRKY , LM.LOCAKY , STD.LOCAKY , STD.LOTA12 , STD.RCVLMT , BZ.PROCHA , AI.QTYASN , AI.QTYASN , SM.ASKU01 , STD.LOTA13
sqlMap.insert: INSERT INTO RECDH ( RECVKY , WAREKY , RCPTTY , STATDO , DOCDAT , DOCCAT , DPTNKY , ARCPTD , OWNRKY , CREDAT, CRETIM, CREUSR , LMODAT, LMOTIM, LMOUSR ) SELECT #RECVKY# , #WAREKY# , #RCPTTY# , 'NEW' , TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD') , '100' , AH.DPTNKY , TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD') , #OWNRKY# , TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD'), TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'HH24MISS'), #SES_USER_ID# , TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD'), TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'HH24MISS'), #SES_USER_ID# FROM ASNDH AH INNER JOIN ASNDI AI ON AI.ASNDKY = AH.ASNDKY WHERE AH.ASNDKY = #ASNDKY# AND ROWNUM = 1

INSERT INTO RECDI ( RECVKY, RECVIT, STATIT, SKUKEY , LOTNUM, AREAKY, LOCAKY, TRNUID , QTYRCV, QTYUOM , MEASKY, UOMKEY, QTPUOM, DUOMKY, QTDUOM
, LOTA01, LOTA02, LOTA03, LOTA04, LOTA05 , LOTA06, LOTA07, LOTA08, LOTA09, LOTA10 , LOTA11, LOTA12, LOTA13, LOTA14, LOTA15 , LOTA16, LOTA17, LOTA18, LOTA19, LOTA20
, AWMSNO, REFDKY, REFDIT, REFCAT, REFDAT , DESC01, DESC02 , ASKU01, ASKU02, ASKU03, ASKU04, ASKU05 , EANCOD, GTINCD , SKUG01, SKUG02, SKUG03, SKUG04, SKUG05 , GRSWGT, NETWGT, WGTUNT , LENGTH, WIDTHW, HEIGHT, CUBICM, CAPACT , QTYORG
, SMANDT, SEBELN, SEBELP, SZMBLNO, SZMIPNO , STRAID, SVBELN, SPOSNR, STKNUM, STPNUM , SWERKS, SLGORT, SDATBG, STDLNR , SSORNU, SSORIT , SMBLNR, SZEILE, SMJAHR, SXBLNR , SBKTXT
, CREDAT, CRETIM, CREUSR , LMODAT, LMOTIM, LMOUSR ) SELECT #RECVKY#, TRIM(TO_CHAR(ROWNUM * 10, '000000')) AS RECVIT, ' ', AI.SKUKEY , ' ' AS LOTNUM, ' ' AS AREAKY, #LOCAKY# AS LOCAKY, NVL(TRIM(#TRNUID#), ' ') AS TRNUID , #QTYRCV# AS QTYRCV, 0 , SW.MEASKY, SM.DUOMKY AS UOMKEY, 1 AS QTPUOM, SM.DUOMKY AS DUOMKY, 1 AS QTDUOM
, NVL(#LOTA01#,' '), NVL(#LOTA02#,' '), NVL(#LOTA03#,' '), NVL(#LOTA04#,' '), NVL(#LOTA05#,' ') , '00' AS LOTA06, NVL(#LOTA07#,' '), NVL(#LOTA08#,' '), NVL(#LOTA09#,' '), NVL(#LOTA10#,' ') , NVL(TRIM(#LOTA11#), '10000101') AS LOTA11, TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD') AS LOTA12, NVL(#LOTA13#,'99991231'), ' ' AS LOTA14, ' ' AS LOTA15 , 0 AS LOTA16, 0 AS LOTA17, 0 AS LOTA18, 0 AS LOTA19, 0 AS LOTA20
, AI.AWMSNO , AH.ASNDKY AS REFDKY , AI.ASNDIT AS REFDIT , '050' AS REFCAT , TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD') AS REFDAT
, SM.DESC01, SM.DESC02 , SM.ASKU01, SM.ASKU02, SM.ASKU03, SM.ASKU04, SM.ASKU05 , SM.EANCOD, SM.GTINCD , SM.SKUG01, SM.SKUG02, SM.SKUG03, SM.SKUG04, SM.SKUG05 , SM.GRSWGT, SM.NETWGT, SM.WGTUNT , SM.LENGTH, SM.WIDTHW, SM.HEIGHT, SM.CUBICM, SM.CAPACT , AI.QTYASN AS QTYORG
, AI.SMANDT, AI.SEBELN, AI.SEBELP, AI.SZMBLNO, AI.SZMIPNO , AI.STRAID, AI.SVBELN, AI.SPOSNR, AI.STKNUM, AI.STPNUM , AI.SWERKS, AI.SLGORT, AI.SDATBG, AI.STDLNR , AI.SSORNU, AI.SSORIT , AI.SMBLNR, AI.SZEILE, AI.SMJAHR, AI.SXBLNR , ' ' AS SBKTXT
, TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD'), TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'HH24MISS'), #SES_USER_ID# , TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD'), TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'HH24MISS'), #SES_USER_ID# FROM ASNDH AH INNER JOIN ASNDI AI ON AI.ASNDKY = AH.ASNDKY INNER JOIN SKUMA SM ON SM.OWNRKY = AH.OWNRKY AND SM.SKUKEY = AI.SKUKEY INNER JOIN SKUWC SW ON SW.WAREKY = AH.WAREKY AND SW.OWNRKY = AH.OWNRKY AND SW.SKUKEY = AI.SKUKEY LEFT OUTER JOIN MEASI MI ON MI.WAREKY = AH.WAREKY AND MI.MEASKY = SW.MEASKY AND MI.UOMKEY = 'BOX' INNER JOIN DOCTM DT ON DT.DOCUTY = AH.ASNTTY LEFT OUTER JOIN WAHMA WF ON WF.WAREKY = AH.DPTNKY WHERE AH.WAREKY = #WAREKY# AND AH.OWNRKY = #OWNRKY# AND AH.ASNDKY = #ASNDKY# AND AI.ASNDIT = #ASNDIT# AND (AI.SKUKEY = #BARCOD# OR SM.EANCOD = #BARCOD# OR SM.GTINCD = #BARCOD#) AND AI.QTYASN - AI.QTYRCV > 0

SELECT #ASNINV# AS ASNINV , ASNDIT AS ASNDIT , #ASNTTY# AS ASNTTY , #SKUKEY# AS SKUKEY , SM.DESC01 , #LOCAKY# AS LOCAKY , AH.DPTNKY AS PTNRKY , AI.EANCOD AS EANCOD , SUM(AI.QTYASN) AS QTYASN , SM.SKUG05 , SM.DUOMKY AS UOMKEY , SM.ASKU01 , ' ' AS TRNUID , 0 AS QTYRCV , SUM(AI.QTYRCV) AS QTYRCV1 , SUM(AI.QTYASN - AI.QTYRCV) AS QTABLE , TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') AS LOTA12 , AI.LOTA11 , AI.LOTA13 , NVL(SUM(SM.QTYMON),1) AS EXPIRED_LIMIT , NVL(SUM(SM.QTYSTD),1) AS WARNING_LIMIT , '99991231' AS RCVLMT FROM ASNDH AH INNER JOIN ASNDI AI ON AI.ASNDKY = AH.ASNDKY INNER JOIN SKUMA SM ON SM.OWNRKY = AH.OWNRKY AND SM.SKUKEY = AI.SKUKEY WHERE AH.WAREKY = #SES_WAREKY# AND AH.OWNRKY = #SES_OWNER# AND AI.QTYASN - AI.QTYRCV > 0 AND AH.ASNDKY = #ASNINV# AND AH.ASNTTY = #ASNTTY# AND AI.ASNDIT = #ASNDIT#
AND AI.LOTA13 = #LOTA13#

SELECT CASE WHEN (#QTY# + SUM(AI.QTYRCV)) > SUM(AI.QTYASN) THEN 'VALID_M1722' ELSE 'OK' END AS MSG FROM ASNDI AI WHERE ASNDKY = #ASNDKY# AND SKUKEY = #SKUKEY#

, SKUKEY, LOTNUM, AREAKY, LOCAKY, TRNUID , QTYRCV, QTYUOM , MEASKY, UOMKEY, QTPUOM, DUOMKY, QTDUOM

, AWMSNO, REFDKY, REFDIT, REFCAT, REFDAT , DESC01, DESC02 , ASKU01, ASKU02, ASKU03, ASKU04, ASKU05 , EANCOD, GTINCD , SKUG01, SKUG02, SKUG03, SKUG04, SKUG05 , GRSWGT, NETWGT, WGTUNT , LENGTH, WIDTHW, HEIGHT, CUBICM, CAPACT , QTYORG

, NVL(#LOTA01#,' '), NVL(#LOTA02#,' '), NVL(#LOTA03#,' '), NVL(#LOTA04#,' '), NVL(#LOTA05#,' ') , '00' AS LOTA06, NVL(#LOTA07#,' '), NVL(#LOTA08#,' '), NVL(#LOTA09#,' '), NVL(#LOTA10#,' ') , NVL(TRIM(#LOTA11#), '10000101') AS LOTA11, TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD') AS LOTA12, NVL(#LOTA13#,'99991231'), ' ' AS LOTA14, ' ' AS LOTA15 , 0 AS LOTA16, 0 AS LOTA17, 0 AS LOTA18, 0 AS LOTA19, 0 AS LOTA20

, SM.DESC01, SM.DESC02 , SM.ASKU01, SM.ASKU02, SM.ASKU03, SM.ASKU04, SM.ASKU05 , SM.EANCOD, SM.GTINCD , SM.SKUG01, SM.SKUG02, SM.SKUG03, SM.SKUG04, SM.SKUG05 , SM.GRSWGT, SM.NETWGT, SM.WGTUNT , SM.LENGTH, SM.WIDTHW, SM.HEIGHT, SM.CUBICM, SM.CAPACT , AI.QTYASN AS QTYORG
, AI.SMANDT, AI.SEBELN, AI.SEBELP, AI.SZMBLNO, AI.SZMIPNO , AI.STRAID, AI.SVBELN, AI.SPOSNR, AI.STKNUM, AI.STPNUM , AI.SWERKS, AI.SLGORT, AI.SDATBG, AI.STDLNR , AI.SSORNU, AI.SSORIT , AI.SMBLNR, AI.SZEILE, AI.SMJAHR, AI.SXBLNR , ' ' AS SBKTXT

SELECT PO.SKUKEY , SM.DESC01 , SW.LOCARV AS LOCAKY , ' ' AS TRNUID , PO.MENGE AS QTYORD , PO.MEINS AS UOMKEY , PO.MENGE_R AS MENGER , (PO.MENGE - PO.MENGE_R - PO.MENGE_B) AS QTYRCV , '00' AS LOTA06 , TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD') AS LOTA11 , '99991231' AS LOTA13 , PO.EBELN AS SEBELN , PO.EBELP AS SEBELP , SM.EANCOD AS EANCOD FROM IFWMS103 PO LEFT OUTER JOIN SKUMA SM ON SM.OWNRKY = 'HNW' AND SM.SKUKEY = PO.SKUKEY LEFT OUTER JOIN SKUWC SW ON SW.WAREKY = PO.WAREKY AND SW.OWNRKY = PO.WERKS AND SW.SKUKEY = PO.SKUKEY WHERE PO.WAREKY = #SES_WAREKY# AND PO.WERKS = #SES_OWNER# AND (PO.EBELN = #SEBELN# OR PO.EBELN||PO.EBELP = #SEBELN#) AND (PO.MENGE - PO.MENGE_R - PO.MENGE_B) > 0 AND PO.STATUS IN ('A','C') AND PO.IFFLG IN ('N')

PO.MENGE_R - PO.MENGE_B) AS QTYRCV1 , (PO.MENGE - PO.MENGE_R - PO.MENGE_B) AS QTYRCV , ' ' AS LOTA01 , ' ' AS LOTA02 , ' ' AS LOTA03 , ' ' AS LOTA04 , ' ' AS LOTA05 , '00' AS LOTA06 , ' ' AS LOTA07 , ' ' AS LOTA08 , ' ' AS LOTA09 , PO.C00101 AS LOTA10 , TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD') AS LOTA11 , TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD') AS LOTA12 , '99991231' AS LOTA13 , ' ' AS LOTA14 , ' ' AS LOTA15 , ' ' AS LOTA16 , ' ' AS LOTA17 , ' ' AS LOTA18 , ' ' AS LOTA19 , ' ' AS LOTA20 , ' ' AS RECVKY , ' ' AS RECVIT FROM IFWMS103 PO LEFT OUTER JOIN SKUMA SM ON SM.OWNRKY = PO.WERKS AND SM.SKUKEY = PO.SKUKEY LEFT OUTER JOIN SKUWC SW ON SW.WAREKY = PO.WAREKY AND SW.OWNRKY = PO.WERKS AND SW.SKUKEY = PO.SKUKEY LEFT OUTER JOIN BZPTN BZ ON BZ.PTNRKY = PO.LIFNR AND BZ.OWNRKY = PO.WERKS AND BZ.PTNRTY = DECODE(SUBSTR(PO.BWART,0,2), '13', 'CT', 'VD') WHERE PO.WAREKY = #SES_WAREKY# AND PO.WERKS = #SES_OWNER# AND PO.BWART = #RCPTTY# AND (PO.EBELN = #SEBELN# OR PO.EBELN||PO.EBELP = #SEBELN#)
